name: Nidaros FMC Winter 2025
information: **Norsk:** Velkommen til Nidaros FMC Winter 2025. Denne konkurransen holder kun Fewest Moves. Denne konkurransen holder **ikke** 3x3. **English:** Welcome to Nidaros FMC Winter 2025. This competition ony holds Fewest Moves. The competition will **not** hold 3x3.
